youtube_description:
Learning for KIDS! Educational children’s show!

Today at Brightest Kids we learn about: The Total Eclipse of the Sun!

The Dancing Shadows
(Original Song)

[Verse]
When the moon and the sun align in the sky
Something magical is bound to catch your eye
It's a total eclipse, oh what a sight to see
Let me tell you the story, come along with me

[Chorus]
Dancing shadows, in the midday sun
A total eclipse, oh so much fun
From ancient legends to cultures old and new
Let's learn about this phenomenon, it's true

[Verse 2]
Long long ago, in lands far away
The people believed it was a sign, a special day
The sun was devoured by a great dragon's jaw
But it always returned, shining brighter than before
